id.description: The unique identifier for the message.

parentId.description: The unique identifier for the parent message.

roomId.description: The room ID of the message.

roomType.description:
The type of room.
 * `direct` - 1:1 room
 * `group` - group room

text.example: PROJECT UPDATE - A new project plan has been published on http://example.com/s/lf5vj. The PM for this project is Mike C. and the Engineering Manager is Jane W.
text.description: The message, in plain text. If `markdown` is specified this parameter may be *optionally* used to provide alternate text for UI clients that do not support rich text.

markdown.example: **PROJECT UPDATE** A new project plan has been published on <http://example.com/s/lf5vj>. The PM for this project is <@personEmail:mike@example.com> and the Engineering Manager is <@personEmail:jane@example.com>.

html.example: PROJECT UPDATE A new project plan has been published here. The PM for this project is mike@example.com and the Engineering Manager is jane@example.com.
html.description: The text content of the message, in HTML format. This read-only property is used by the Webex clients.

files.description: Public URLs for files attached to the message. For the supported media types and the behavior of file uploads, see [Message Attachments](/docs/basics#message-attachments).

personId.description: The person ID of the message author.

personEmail.description: The email address of the message author.

mentionedPeople.description: People IDs for anyone mentioned in the message.

mentionedGroups.description: Group names for the groups mentioned in the message.

attachments.description: Message content attachments attached to the message. See the [Cards Guide](/docs/buttons-and-cards) for more information.

created.description: The date and time the message was created.

updated.description: The date and time that the message was last edited by the author. This field is only present when the message contents have changed.

isVoiceClip.description: `true` if the audio file is a voice clip recorded by the client; `false` if the audio file is a standard audio file not posted using the voice clip feature.

type.description:
The type of attachment.
 * `external` - Attachment stored externally.
 * `native` - Attachment stored within the Webex platform.
